scenes.title: 先动的一下
scenes.action: 同一成人站在一束侧光里，墙上的投影提前抬手，随后本人跟上。
scenes.composition: Pure2D same human and his attached/detached wall shadow; body in y430..1290; subtitle band clear

scenes.title: 被记住的生活
scenes.action: 同一人在桌边删字、停顿；琥珀文字碎屑流入身后的影子。
scenes.composition: Pure2D same human and his attached/detached wall shadow; body in y430..1290; subtitle band clear

scenes.title: 暗处演练
scenes.action: 人扶住胸口、转头；影子反复做同一个动作，由迟滞到同步。
scenes.feeling: 理解是被一遍遍学习的
scenes.composition: Pure2D same human and his attached/detached wall shadow; body in y430..1290; subtitle band clear

scenes.title: 比你还像你
scenes.action: 两具相同姿态重合，相同的袖口/手势细节在影子上发暖金光。
scenes.composition: Pure2D same human and his attached/detached wall shadow; body in y430..1290; subtitle band clear

scenes.title: 人生的路口
scenes.action: 桌子淡出，门框与确认台出现；人向前一步，右手悬在按钮之前。
scenes.composition: Pure2D same human and his attached/detached wall shadow; body in y430..1290; subtitle band clear

scenes.title: 影子越过本人
scenes.action: 本人手停在按钮前；影子从脚边脱开，伸臂在3900帧按下确认。
scenes.composition: Pure2D same human and his attached/detached wall shadow; body in y430..1290; subtitle band clear

scenes.title: 认证通过
scenes.action: 确认光扩散，金色影子占据前景，本人变冷、留在背后的投影中。
scenes.composition: Pure2D same human and his attached/detached wall shadow; body in y430..1290; subtitle band clear

scenes.title: 谁在替谁活
scenes.action: 4500–4530无声；双心跳后前景人物继续向前，原人留作影子，眼部有手机可见的冷青细光。
scenes.composition: Pure2D same human and his attached/detached wall shadow; body in y430..1290; subtitle band clear
